On January 29, 2026, the Turkish Football Federation issued a fine of 802,500 lira (approximately $18,500) to Amed S.F.K. Additionally, the federation suspended the club's president, Nahit Eren, from football-related activities for 15 days. This action was taken for "damaging the reputation of football" by "making ideological propaganda," following the club's posting of a video that was interpreted as a political statement.
